headers.comment: Security headers on every response (defense-in-depth; the app has no HTML-injection sink today, this guards against future drift). CSP notes: script-src pins index.html's ONE inline script (the no-flash theme/lang bootstrap) by its sha256 hash instead of 'unsafe-inline', plus https://apis.google.com — Firebase Auth's signInWithPopup dynamically loads the gapi script from there, and without the origin the Google sign-in dies with auth/internal-error (prod outage 2026-07-24) — injected inline scripts are refused, only that exact text runs (src/test/csp.test.ts recomputes the hash from index.html and fails the build-gate when the script changes without updating this header). style-src still needs 'unsafe-inline' because React sets inline style attributes (RangeSlider/StatsPage bars). worker-src allows blob: because Sentry Replay spawns its compression worker from a blob: URL — 'self' alone blocked it (console CSP error on every prod load). connect-src covers Firestore/Auth/Storage (*.googleapis.com incl. long-polling), the Google sign-in helper (accounts.google.com — narrowed from *.google.com, which the auth flow doesn't need beyond this host) and Sentry ingest; frame-src covers the Google sign-in popup/iframe (authDomain on firebaseapp.com + accounts.google.com); img-src allows the app's own assets, object-URL photo previews (blob:), Storage downloads and Google avatars — the avatar host is a WILDCARD because Google rotates profile photos across lh1..lh6.googleusercontent.com (a single lh3 entry breaks the avatar for any user served from another shard). If a legit origin ever gets blocked, loosen the single directive — or drop this block wholesale to roll back.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-p/SRST1i6cCdp1wXujPC9IqNvvzNn4Q1g9DDigunnR8=' https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://accounts.google.com https://*.ingest.de.sentry.io https://*.ingest.sentry.io; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com https://*.googleusercontent.com; frame-src https://*.firebaseapp.com https://accounts.google.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'

headers.comment: version.json, index.html and sw.js must never be cached. A stale version.json/index.html would hide a new build from a long-open tab; a stale sw.js would pin an old service worker (Firebase Hosting's default 1h cache would otherwise delay every SW update by up to an hour).
Hashed build assets are content-addressed, so they can be cached forever.
